import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    l = int(data[1])
    r = int(data[2])
    
    # Create a mask with all bits set from L to R (1-indexed from left)
    # Total bits needed
    total_bits = r
    # Create mask: (2^(r-l+1) - 1) << (total_bits - r)
    # Or equivalently, set bits from position (total_bits - r) to (total_bits - l)
    num_bits = r - l + 1
    mask = ((1 << num_bits) - 1) << (total_bits - r)
    
    result = n | mask
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
